verdict.rationale: Post-Incident Reviews are documented to 'coordinate preventative follow-up actions' [pagerduty-docs-36, pagerduty-docs-38]. The Scribe Agent records action items from incident calls [pagerduty-docs-63]. That covers capturing and coordinating follow-ups, but nothing shows those actions being tracked to completion or synced to an issue tracker. Generic webhooks and the integration catalog would only make syncing possible as a custom build. Missing for 10: documented status tracking of action items through completion, a native two-way sync of follow-ups to Jira or other issue trackers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
